BIMODAL (SHOPIFY-OAUTH-FIRST-01 / D13). Historical mode (state carries merchantAccountId, session-initiated via /api/shopify/install): verifyOAuthHmac(searchParams, clientSecret) at the cited line, after verifyState(stateCookie) confronted the callback's `state` query param with the signed cookie payload's nonce and the shop domain; the admin client is constructed afterwards, then the ownership guard (APP-03 / Lot 1) and app-switch guard run before any write. No-session mode (state WITHOUT merchantAccountId, issued by app/api/shopify/entry/[appLabel]/route.ts): handleNoSessionCallback applies the same state/nonce/domain/HMAC guards (no fallback to the default app: a state without clientId is refused) BEFORE constructing the admin client, which then only runs performNoSessionAuthorization (lib/shopify/no-session-authorization.ts): app-switch rule, Shopify token lease, code exchange, then decide_and_write_shopify_authorization (0160, service_role-only) — the DB picks the branch and resolves the owner; the tenant never comes from the request. Branch 2 writes nothing in `shop` (pending installation + ticket cookie). Proven by tests/unit/shopify-oauth-first-callback.test.ts and tests/rls/shopify-oauth-first-01.rls.test.ts (guards mutation-tested).

performShopifyEmbeddedLink: verifyEmbeddedLinkIntent (signed continuation, line 112) then a membership+role check via ctx.supabase (RLS-respecting, merchant_member filtered on ctx.userId + input.merchantAccountId, line 131-151 — refuses any role outside owner/manager, named 'insufficient_role') before the admin client is constructed (line 152). The admin client does the initial global read (detecting a shop owned by another tenant, invisible under RLS), then two more guards run before any write: decideShopAppSwitch (line 163) and decideShopOwnership (line 171, APP-03/Lot 1, reused unmodified). SEC-SHOP-CLAIM-01 (migration 0155): authenticated has NO INSERT/UPDATE privilege on shop (table-level revoke, zero column re-granted), so the write is the service_role-only RPC link_shopify_embedded_shop_fenced (0159, line 206; same body as 0155, preceded by a generation check under the Shopify token lease acquired at line 194 and released afterwards — SHOPIFY-EXPIRING-TOKENS-01), called with ctx.userId (server session), input.merchantAccountId, and the shop domain + client_id of the VERIFIED intent — never a browser-supplied identity. security invoker, so RLS no longer applies: the RPC re-derives under row lock what shop_insert/shop_update enforced implicitly — merchant role of p_user_id in p_merchant_account_id at write time (not_a_member / insufficient_role), shop_member role on an existing shop (insufficient_role), app switch (app_switch_refused), tenant ownership (ownership_refused). Named RPC refusals are relayed; any other result is a fail-closed write_failed. Proven against real Postgres, privileges and RPC, each guard mutation-tested: tests/rls/sec-shop-claim-01-domain-preemption.rls.test.ts, tests/rls/shopify-embedded-link-rls.rls.test.ts.

performShopifyAppRelease: role/tenant derived independently from merchant_member via ctx.supabase (RLS-respecting, filtered on ctx.userId, line 106-111) — refuses non-owner as 'insufficient_role' and non-member as 'not_a_member' before the admin client is ever constructed. shop and store_connection are READ via ctx.supabase too (shop_select/store_connection_select policies). The admin client (line 187) writes store_connection and store_connection_webhook_token (no INSERT/UPDATE policy for authenticated on either, confirmed by direct catalog read). SEC-SHOP-CLAIM-01 (migration 0155): authenticated has NO INSERT/UPDATE privilege on shop, so the final shop.shopify_client_id -> NULL write is the service_role-only RPC release_shopify_shop_app_identity_fenced (0159, line 259; same guards as 0155, then preemption of the Shopify token lease before the write, released right after — SHOPIFY-EXPIRING-TOKENS-01), called with ctx.userId, the shop id already validated under RLS and the old client_id. security invoker: the RPC re-derives under row lock the owner role on the ROW's tenant (not_a_member / insufficient_role), the shop_member role that shop_update enforced implicitly (insufficient_role), and the compare-and-set status=uninstalled + old client_id (state_changed); only 'released' is a success. Every admin write is a compare-and-set scoped by id + merchant_account_id (+ status/old-value predicates) — never a bare id. Proven against real Postgres, including concurrent-call and cross-tenant/role refusal, each RPC guard mutation-tested: tests/rls/shopify-app-release.rls.test.ts, tests/rls/sec-shop-claim-01-domain-preemption.rls.test.ts.

SHOPIFY-OAUTH-FIRST-01 / B1 — EXCEPTION NOMMÉE D16a. verifyShopifyEntryQuery (lib/shopify/entry.ts) checks the Shopify-signed application_url query (HMAC of the app named by the path, unique shop/timestamp/hmac params, ±5 min window, myshopify domain) BEFORE the admin client is constructed. The admin client then calls ONLY classify_shopify_entry (0160, service_role-only, returns an enum — no tenant, no credential) and, for an installed classification, reads the access/refresh ciphertexts of that one shop to test decryption in memory (D19; never returned nor logged). No write on any branch. Proven by tests/unit/shopify-oauth-first-entry.test.ts (each guard mutation-tested) and tests/rls/shopify-oauth-first-01.rls.test.ts.

SHOPIFY-OAUTH-FIRST-01 / B3 — READ-ONLY GET (app/shopify/claim/page.tsx renders what this loader returns). The admin client only calls read_shopify_pending_installation (0160, service_role-only, STABLE, returns state + shop domain + app client id — never a credential nor an internal id), keyed by the sha256 of the httpOnly/Lax ticket cookie scoped to /shopify/claim (lib/shopify/claim-ticket.ts). A malformed ticket never reaches the database. Session, membership (same read as requireRole) and account name go through the RLS session client. No write on any branch (T15, proven against real Postgres with the SQL read mutated into a write: tests/rls/shopify-oauth-first-01.rls.test.ts). The attachment itself is the POST server action (owner/manager re-checked server-side and in SQL).

SHOPIFY-OAUTH-FIRST-01 / B4 — POST server action, treated as directly reachable. requireRole('owner','manager') at the cited line re-authenticates and re-checks the role on every call (Next's Origin check admits requests WITHOUT Origin, so it is never relied upon). User and tenant come from the session (ctx.user.id, ctx.member.merchantAccountId); the input schema is empty; the ticket is read ONLY from its httpOnly/SameSite=Lax cookie scoped to /shopify/claim. The admin client runs performShopifyClaim (lib/shopify/claim-core.ts): read_shopify_pending_installation, the Shopify token lease, consume_shopify_pending_installation (0160, service_role-only: role re-checked under lock, ownership then app, stale pending D22, fenced persist, audit, ticket consumed in one transaction), write_shopify_store_connection_fenced, and the shopify.claim_refused audit written in the REQUESTER tenant only. Proven by tests/unit/shopify-oauth-first-claim-action.test.ts, tests/rls/shopify-oauth-first-01.rls.test.ts and tests/e2e/shopify-claim-csrf.spec.ts (guards mutation-tested).
